criteria.CAN-USER: An authorized customer can cancel their own unfulfilled order and its stock is released.
criteria.CAN-IDEMPOTENT: Repeated cancellation is idempotent: stock is released once and one audit entry exists.
criteria.CAN-PERMISSION: Another customer cannot cancel the order.
criteria.CAN-ERROR: Cancelling an unknown order returns not found.
criteria.CAN-AUDIT: Audit history of the cancellation remains queryable.
